subject: Marketplace reseller addendum — CloudWave (holdback & pass-through clarification)
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@cloudwave.io>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aakash Rao <aakash.rao@cloudwave.io>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace addendum draft — initial terms and holdback proposal

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the demo last week. Attached is CloudWave's standard reseller/marketplace addendum (PDF) we typically use when listing a vendor on our marketplace. A few points we wanted to highlight up front:

- We propose a 10% holdback of gross marketplace receipts for 90 days to cover chargebacks and dispute resolution.
- Marketplace fees (platform, card processing, marketplace service fees) are passed through to the vendor and/or deducted from payouts per our Order Flow section.
- We included a clause requiring vendors to accept CloudWave-issued invoices as the primary billing artifact for customers purchasing via marketplace.

Could you confirm whether Redwood is comfortable with the holdback duration/percent and the pass-through invoicing flow? We're fine to walk through these and accept limited redlines — our legal team is cc'd (Aakash).

Attaching: CloudWave_Addendum_Draft_v1.pdf

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Head of Partnerships — CloudWave
Maria.Lopez@cloudwave.io
+1 (415) 555-0123

--

[attachment: CloudWave_Addendum_Draft_v1.pdf (pdf)]
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@cloudwave.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum draft — initial terms and holdback proposal

Hi Maria —

Appreciate the draft and the clear summary. A few quick reactions from our side while I loop in legal and our marketplace ops lead (Ben/Marissa):

- Holdback: 10% for 90 days is higher than our standard marketplace practice (we typically see 0–5% and shorter windows). Please confirm the customer dispute profile that drives 90 days. Is this an industry-specific exposure?
- Pass-through wording: we need to align on whether Redwood invoices customers directly (gross) or whether CloudWave remits net payouts and Redwood invoices CloudWave. Our preferred flow is Redwood invoices end-customers for consumption and CloudWave remits platform fees back to Redwood where applicable — or alternatively, CloudWave can invoice Redwood for platform fees monthly. We need clarity on invoicing artifacts accepted for audit.
- Indemnity and liability caps: the addendum currently references broad indemnities tied to marketplace listings. Legal, please advise whether we accept carve-outs for third-party marketplace processing fees.

I've attached a first-pass redline (RN_redline_cloudwave_addendum.docx) with comments. Legal (Kimberly) — can you review and call out any non-starters? Ben/Marissa — ops questions below:
  * Can we support a 90-day reconciliation window operationally? What data exports will CloudWave provide for reconciliation?
  * If we need to invoice CloudWave for platform fees instead of the end-customer flow, how does that impact our revenue recognition?

Happy to set a 30–40 minute sync this week if helpful.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Channel Sales, Redwood Inference
Tessa.Morgan@redwoodinference.com

[attachment: RN_redline_cloudwave_addendum.docx (docx)]
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum draft — operational quick notes

Tessa / Marissa —

Quick ops take:
- 90 days is aggressive from our side for a holdback. If CloudWave insists on holdback, I recommend we push to 4–6 weeks (30–45 days) with a monthly reconciliation cadence. That limits cash flow impact and keeps disputes manageable.
- We require a daily or at least weekly transaction export (CSV) that includes order id, timestamp, customer email, SKU, gross amount, platform fee, and payout amount. Without that we can't reconcile.
- If CloudWave wants to be the billing entity, they must provide evidence of tax collection and full invoice trails. Otherwise Redwood will prefer to invoice end-customers and pay CloudWave their share net.

If legal confirms the holdback language is negotiable, I'll draft a short operational appendix for the addendum that clarifies the reconciliation data points.

-Ben
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@cloudwave.io>, Aakash Rao <aakash.rao@cloudwave.io>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum draft — legal comments and proposed language

Hi Maria / Aakash —

Thanks for sharing the addendum. Attached are Redwood's legal comments (legal_comments_20270630.pdf) and a redlined version with proposed language. High-level positions:

1) Holdback: We cannot accept an open 10% holdback for 90 days as drafted. Proposed compromise: allow up to 5% holdback and limit the holdback release period to 45 days following invoice/payment, except where fraud or chargeback investigation is ongoing (we'll require notice and reasonably detailed supporting information).

2) Pass-through invoicing: Redwood proposes the following two alternative flows (pick one in the addendum):
   a) Redwood invoices the end-customer (gross). CloudWave remits platform fees to Redwood via monthly invoice, supported by the transaction export.
   b) CloudWave invoices Redwood for platform fees only; Redwood will invoice end-customers and make net payouts.
We need an explicit data/export spec in the addendum (daily/weekly export, schema included) to support either flow.

3) Liability and indemnity: Carve out marketplace processing fees from vendor indemnity where the fees relate only to CloudWave's payment processing. Redwood will accept indemnity limited to Redwood's negligence/willful misconduct. Caps to be mutual and tied to the SOW/order form value for the prior 12 months.

4) Audit & compliance: Redwood requests SOC 2 Type II report (last 12 months) or equivalent and a modest SLA on availability for marketplace listing endpoints.

5) Implementation note for ops: include a short reconciliation appendix that Ben/Marissa can own; the appendix should capture file format, required fields, reconciliation cadence, and dispute resolution steps.

If CloudWave is open to the 5%/45-day compromise and adding the reconciliation appendix, we can move forward quickly. Otherwise, please let us know which items are non-negotiable for you and we can escalate to execs.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum draft — legal comments and proposed language

Thanks Kimberly — helpful and pragmatic. Maria/Aakash — can you confirm whether CloudWave can accept the 5%/45-day compromise and add the reconciliation appendix (we've sketched the required fields)? If yes, Ben and I will prepare the operational appendix and sign off on the redline so we can send a final to your team.

I'll set up a 30-minute call for tomorrow to resolve any remaining points.

Best,
Tessa
